Subject: Clarifying PO requirement for BridgeByte pilot

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week — excited to kick off the 30-day pilot. Our finance team asked a quick question about purchase order requirements before we get the first invoice scheduled.

BridgeByte is a small vendor; the pilot SOW shows a single month fee of $2,900. Do you require a purchase order from us for that amount, or can we proceed on an invoice-only trial for the initial month? If a PO is required, please let me know any fields/format you need (account code, buyer contact) so we can circulate internally.

I attached the short SOW (BridgeByte_SOW_Q4.pdf) for reference.

Quick answers appreciated — our kickoff is Monday if possible.

Best,
Anika Shah

BridgeByte

Hi Anika — thanks for sending the SOW and flagging timing.

Short answer: we generally require a PO for vendor invoices, but there is an exception process for small pilot engagements. I've looped in Sean and Marissa from procurement/finance to confirm the threshold and any evidence we'll need.

Two quick options to keep you moving:
- If BridgeByte can provide a signed SOW + W-9 and insurance cert, procurement may approve a one-time invoice-only route for the first month.
- Otherwise we can accept a vendor PO; typical fields we need are: Redwood account (RDW-00123), Invoice-to contact (billing@redwoodinference.com), and our GL code (TBD by finance).

Can Sean/Marissa advise? We'd like to avoid delaying the kickoff.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Clarifying PO requirement for BridgeByte pilot

Logan — thanks for the tag.

Procurement policy summary (short):
- Default: PO required for any external supplier once a contract/SOW is in place.
- Exception: Invoice-only onboarding can be approved for first-time pilots/trials where the total liability is under $5,000 and the vendor is low-risk. Approval requires a minimal evidence package and a timebound authorization.

For BridgeByte specifically (SOW total $2,900): we can grant an invoice-only path for the initial 30-day pilot provided we receive the following prior to first invoice:
1) Signed SOW (scanned PDF)
2) Completed W-9 (or foreign equivalent)
3) Certificate of insurance (general liability typical)
4) Vendor registration form completed (attestation of ownership, bank details masked)

I've attached our procurement-evidence-checklist.pdf that we use to assess small-vendor exceptions. If the package is complete we can approve up to $3,500 for the trial window and log an internal temporary PO override so accounting can route the invoice. This is a one-time waiver; subsequent months will need a regular PO or a contract amendment.

If anyone in Finance (Aditya) wants to weigh in on GL code mapping or escrow concerns, please advise.

I'll tentatively approve once the items above are in hand — happy to sign off quickly to prevent the kickoff from slipping.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Anika — looping back with approval and next steps.

Thank you for the SOW. Based on Sean's guidance we will approve an invoice-only path for the initial 30-day BridgeByte pilot with a cap of $3,500. Conditions:

- This waiver is timebound: covers invoices dated between 2026-11-22 and 2026-12-22. Any work/invoices beyond that window require a standard PO or contract amendment.
- Redwood will record an internal temporary PO override for accounting; please include BridgeByte invoice number and our Redwood account RDW-00123 on the invoice.

DocuSign (SOW & forms): https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abc123-bridgebyte-sow
HubSpot ticket: BRIDGE-789 (we'll attach the evidence there).

Anika — once we have W-9 + COI we will confirm and notify accounting to accept the first invoice. If you prefer to issue a PO from your side instead, that's also acceptable and will simplify month-two invoicing.

Looking forward to the kickoff Monday — Logan, please confirm internal kickoff time and I'll share the temporary PO reference.

Best,
Marissa Cole
